newsitem.title: USA: MBNA ups qtly div to $0.12/shr post split.
newsitem.headline: MBNA ups qtly div to $0.12/shr post split.

text.p: MBNA Corp said Tuesday it has increased its quarterly dividend to $0.12 per share on a post-split basis.
On a pre-split basis, before a three-for-two split, the rate is equivalent to increasing the quarterly dividend to $0.18 per share from $0.16 per share.
The move will increase the annual rate to $0.48 per share on a post-split basis. On a pre-split basis, the annual rate would increase to $0.72 per share from $0.64 per share.
The dividend is payable April 1 to shareholders of record as of March 17.
